text:
alex: Support -> CS escalation: Saffron Med trial ingestion failing during large batch import. Support saw mixed 429/502s. Trial demo in ~24h; AE flagged renewal at-risk. Need a short comm plan + mitigation.

ria: Thanks Alex. Do we have the error snippet? Any sign it's an auth/quota or runner-side issue? :mag:

frank: paste from proxy: `2025-01-12T04:03:10Z WARN rate_limiter tenant=saffron qps=950 limit=800` then `2025-01-12T04:03:22Z ERROR proxy upstream read timeout model-runner-4` Looks like sustained burst above tenant qps then runner slowdowns. No 401s.

frank: Ops mitigation options: (1) temporarily raise tenant QPS for the ingest window, (2) flip the route to `embed-high-throughput` (note: small diff in normalization), (3) ask customer to lower concurrency and batch size. Command to increase QPS: `infra tenant update-qps saffron --qps 1400 --note "trial ingest bump"`

alex: Let's avoid model switch to keep embeddings identical. Plan: quick QPS bump + ask customer to reduce concurrency to 3 and batch_size 12 for tonight. Ria can you send the note? I'll tag renewal-risk and notify AE.

ria: Drafting now (will send in 5m): "Hi Saffron team 97 we97re seeing intermittent throttling during large import jobs. Could you pause parallel workers and set concurrency to 3 and batch_size to 12 for tonight's seed? We're applying a temporary capacity bump on our side and will update in 20 minutes." Add ETA?

alex: Add ETA: confirm within 20m, target full resolution in 3 hours. Also mention we won't re-run prior completed vectors. Keep messaging concise.

frank: QPS bump applied at 1785054360. ops-bot: TASK-9123 created for monitoring. Autoscale provisional rule applied for model-runner-4 cpu>65% -> scale.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20250112-09 opened by frank 97 priority=P1 97 saffron ingest throttling. PD notified. https://redwood.incidents/INC-20250112-09

ria: Message sent at 1785054380. Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll throttle now and let you know. Will this change embeddings?"

frank: Clarify: bump does NOT change model weights; embeddings unchanged unless we switch models. Sending that to customer.

alex: AE notified and renewal-risk flagged. Action owners: frank=ops bump & monitor, ria=customer comm & post-demo recap, alex=renewal playbook + PM follow-up for pre-warm improvements.

frank: 10m check @1785054920: error spikes reduced to near zero, CPU on model-runner-4 peaked then dropped after autoscale. Keeping monitors 4h.

ria: Preparing customer-facing recap to send after demo: include timeline, what we changed, and recommended ingest best-practices. Also proposing a proactive pre-warm option for large trial ingests; will coordinate with PM.

alex: Closing CS handoff for now. Will attach incident and transcript to renewal-risk ticket and schedule follow-up. Reopen if errors recur. :white_check_mark:
